messages.text: Hey team, I've got {{CLIENT_NAME:c_0070}} on the line, says their debit card got declined at a grocery store twice this morning. Checking account looks fine on my end, balance is healthy. Anyone seen decline issues today?
Nothing on my side so far. Can you see the decline reason code in the card auth log for {{CARD_NUMBER:a_00152}}?
Pulling it now. Looks like it's coming back as a 'suspected fraud' hold, not insufficient funds. So the rule engine flagged it.
Catherine, before you do anything, make sure you've verified the member with the full MFA questions. If they pass, you can release the fraud hold from the card controls screen.
Already verified, they passed everything. They confirmed both grocery attempts were theirs and also a gas station charge yesterday.
FYI I had a member at the teller line earlier saying their card worked fine at the pump, so it doesn't look like a CardProcessor outage. Probably just individual flags.
Good to know Max, thanks. CoreBanking is up and the auth feed has been normal per #it, so I agree this is a one-off rule trigger.
Hold released. I told them to try a small purchase while we're still on the phone. Also noting it in MemberCRM so the history is there.

Nice. Did you ask if they've traveled recently or changed their phone number? Sometimes that trips the velocity rule. I can see the contact on file is {{CLIENT_PHONE:c_0070}}, just confirm it's still current.
Yep, confirmed the number is still good, and they haven't traveled. They did buy a new phone last week though, so maybe a new device pattern with the digital wallet.
That tracks. Catherine, please add a travel/wallet note and let them know to call us if it happens again. We can also look at whether the wallet token needs to be re-provisioned.
Update: test purchase went through at the grocery store, member is happy. They'd also like a text alert set up for any future declines. Where do I enable that in OnlineBanking?
Alerts are under Card Controls > Notifications in the member's profile on the staff view. Or they can self-enable in the mobile app under Alerts. Walk them through it if they're up for it.

Side note, I also had a member earlier with the same kind of decline for {{CLIENT_NAME:c_0023}}. Checking account {{ACCOUNT_NUMBER:a_00050}} shows no issues, so I'll look at the card log the same way Catherine did.
Max, go ahead and check the reason code first, and loop Joanna in since she's their advocate. If it's another fraud-rule flag, we should tally these and send the pattern to Operations.
On it. Max, ping me once you have the code and I'll reach out to {{CLIENT_NAME:c_0023}} directly. I'll also start a quick list of today's fraud-rule declines for Rita Solano's team.
